The episode describes using the pattern on LEO, V.CHAD and V.IOMMI, and as lining in SLASH and SCHENKER items.
LEO’s official product page describes a 100% silk scarf with a graphic inspired by da Vinci’s style and symbolic motifs/hidden messages; it does not identify their meaning.
